slides.headline: How to Fix the 500 Internal Server Error
slides.output: PHP Fatal error: Allowed memory size exhausted in /wp-includes/functions.php
slides.successLine: Solution: Increase memory_limit to 512M in cPanel PHP Selector
slides.body: The infamous white screen of death in WordPress is almost always caused by PHP memory exhaustion or a corrupted .htaccess file.

caption:
Seeing a 500 Internal Server Error on your WordPress site? Don’t panic! 🛠️

9 times out of 10, it is simply PHP running out of memory. Log into your cPanel, navigate to Select PHP Version, and raise memory_limit to 256M or 512M.
